vocabulary_focus.concept: Please inform me / Let me know

expressions.en: Please inform me / Let me know
expressions.cn: 请告诉我 / 让我知道 (Qǐng gàosù wǒ / Ràng wǒ zhīdào)
expressions.bm_formal: Sila maklumkan saya / Mohon maklumkan saya.

expressions.cn: 我明白了 / 知道了 (Wǒ míngbái le / Zhīdào le)

vocabulary_focus.concept: Could you please? / Can you help?

expressions.en: Could you please? / Can you help me with?
expressions.cn: 你能帮我吗？ / 麻烦你 (Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma? / Máfan nǐ)
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh tolong saya? / Harap dapat bantu saya?

vocabulary_focus.concept: I'll get back to you / I will revert

expressions.en: I'll get back to you / I will revert
expressions.cn: 我会回复你 / 我会再联系你 (Wǒ huì huífù nǐ / Wǒ huì zài liánxì nǐ)
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan maklum balas kemudian. / Saya akan berikan maklum balas.
expressions.bm_casual: Nanti saya reply. / Nanti saya bagitau balik.

vocabulary_focus.concept: Sorry for the inconvenience / My apologies

expressions.en: Sorry for the inconvenience / My apologies
expressions.cn: 抱歉造成不便 / 对不起 (Bàoqiàn zàochéng bùbiàn / Duìbùqǐ)
expressions.bm_formal: Maaf atas kesulitan ini. / Saya memohon maaf.

expressions.en: Let's discuss this / Let's talk about it
expressions.cn: 我们来讨论一下 / 咱们聊聊 (Wǒmen lái tǎolùn yīxià / Zánmen liáo liáo)
expressions.bm_formal: Mari kita bincangkan. / Cadangan untuk berbincang.

work.scenario: You are in a team meeting discussing a new project deadline. Your manager asks for an update on your task, and you need to request some data from a colleague to proceed.
key_phrases: Sila maklumkan saya tentang kemajuan tugas anda.
Boleh tolong saya dapatkan data tersebut?
Saya akan maklum balas kemudian setelah data diterima.

life.scenario: You're planning a weekend outing with friends. You need to confirm the time with everyone and ask someone to bring snacks.
key_phrases: Kabar saya bila dah confirm masa.
Boleh tolong bawa snek untuk kita semua?
Jom sembang pasal aktiviti lain nanti.

tech.scenario: You're facing a technical glitch on your laptop during an important presentation. You message your IT support for help and need to confirm when they can fix it.
key_phrases: Boleh tolong saya baiki laptop ni segera?
Nanti saya reply dengan maklumat penuh masalah.
Maaf atas kesulitan ini, saya harap dapat bantuan cepat.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you formally say 'Please inform me about the meeting time.' in Malay?
quiz_toggle.answer: Sila maklumkan saya tentang masa mesyuarat.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you casually say 'Got it, I'll proceed.' in Malay?
How do you formally say 'Could you please help me check this report?' in Malay?
quiz_toggle.answer: Boleh tolong saya semak laporan ini?

quiz_toggle.question: How do you casually say 'I'll get back to you with the details.' in Malay?
How do you formally say 'My apologies for the inconvenience caused by the delay.' in Malay?
quiz_toggle.answer: Saya memohon maaf atas kesulitan yang disebabkan oleh kelewatan ini.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you casually say 'Let's discuss the new proposal.' in Malay?
